title: Singular short answers with olla
focus: Answer positive and negative olla questions with the correct viewpoint and polarity.

exercises.instruction: Choose the reply that matches the stated fact.
exercises.prompt: The question is “Oletko sinä myöhässä?” (“Are you late?”). One person answers about themself. Give the reply “Yes, I am.”
exercises.explanation: Kyllä confirms the positive fact, and olen agrees with the person who answers or is described.

Correct. Kyllä confirms the positive fact, and olen agrees with the person who answers or is described.
“En ole.” does not fit this subject or construction. Kyllä confirms the positive fact, and olen agrees with the person who answers or is described.
“Kyllä, olet.” does not fit this subject or construction. Kyllä confirms the positive fact, and olen agrees with the person who answers or is described.

parts.role: answer word: confirms the positive fact
parts.formation: fixed answer word; no ending is added

parts.role: verb: agrees with the person answering or being described
parts.formation: minä takes olen
